findings: The saved www.deepl.com entry was queried after the tab redirected to auth.deepl.com.
Background tabs were closed at turn completion, preventing reuse in a follow-up.
Password errors lost the fixed host diagnostic and became generic HTTP 400 errors.
The model retried refs, used a wrong native fill argument and reopened tabs.

qualification: This records the existing user session and deterministic/native verification. It does not claim a new successful real-model login, authenticated account session, or improved model latency.

development_restart.cause: macOS hidden,compressed,dataless placeholders blocked filesystem reads/writes of bundled help files in the existing Test project. Generated copies were replaced atomically from the app bundle.
